messages:
sam: Customer (acct: redwood-acct-112) reports huge tail latency and duplicate billing events for single user request. They say the SDK retried and hit two different regions within ~200ms. attaching logs snippet.

laura: oh no. do we have request_ids or region headers from the logs? can you paste the raw trace?

sam: paste below — note two distinct hops and different route ids. looks like hedged requests and fallback landed in eu-west-1 and us-west-2: 
```
request_id=rr-abc123 route=us-west-2 latency_ms=120 status=200 host=api.us-west-2.redwood.internal
request_id=rr-abc123-alt route=eu-west-1 latency_ms=90 status=200 host=api.eu-west-1.redwood.internal
```

sam: They say client sees two successful responses (one slightly later) and their billing shows two token charges for the same logical call.

tony: which SDK/version? hedging + non-sticky routing could cause that if SDK treats hedge as independent requests.

sam: SDK: js-sdk v1.8.2, default config. customer code sets no explicit region. config they provided: 
```
{
  "hedged_requests": true,
  "hedge_timeout_ms": 120,
  "max_retries": 3,
  "region_policy": "auto"
}
```

mira: ok that region_policy=auto is the culprit — hedged workers can pick different endpoints in auto mode. we should reproduce locally. can someone gist a small repro?

laura: quick repro I ran: set REGION=none, call sdk.generate with hedging on. logs show same request_id prefix but parallel calls to two endpoints. snippet: 
```
await client.generate({prompt: 'hi', hedged: true})
// -> two outgoing connections: api.us-west-2... and api.eu-west-1...
```

tony: that aligns. two independent upstreams means two billable token streams. billing should dedupe on upstream if we accept first response and cancel other, but cancellation racing is racy. right now we charge both.

sam: customer is asking for mitigation and a repro so they can roll back. they want a setting to force sticky affinity to a single region for the request lifecycle.

eng-runtime: assigning thread. short-term workaround: set env var REDWOOD_REGION_AFFINITY=sticky which forces the SDK to pin the first chosen endpoint for hedged calls. not currently public, but we can flip it for the tenant.

devex-bot: note: internal flag REDWOOD_REGION_AFFINITY was added in sdk v1.9.0-alpha, not in stable.

mira: can we flip server-side so customer doesn't need client upgrade? e.g., treat hedged duplicates as same logical request and refund duplicates?

tony: server dedupe would help but requires consistent request_id propagation from client. current clients don't propagate a deterministically unique per-logical-call id when hedging. we could accept first response and mark token stream from later responses as non-billable if header x-incoming-parent-id matches — needs infra change.

laura: immediate options for customer: 1) set REDWOOD_REGION_AFFINITY=sticky in their env (we can enable for them), 2) disable hedging in SDK config (hedged_requests=false), 3) update to sdk >=1.9.x alpha to get sticky by default.

billing: if you give tenant id I can queue a provisional credit while we investigate. invoice hits are reversible pending outcome.

sam: tenant id = redwood-acct-112. customer impact: high (production traffic), they have a legal audit request. please expedite.

eng-runtime: steps I'm taking: 1) reproduce with js-sdk v1.8.2 using their config, 2) run controlled hedged test with region affinity toggled, 3) prototype server-side duplicate charge suppression if client-propagated id present. will update within 24h.

mira: please include exact repro (script + env) so support can attach to ticket. laura can you paste your repro script?

laura: yep — small node script: 
```
// repro.js
const { RedwoodClient } = require('@redwood/sdk');
const client = new RedwoodClient({ hedged_requests: true, hedge_timeout_ms: 120 });
(async ()=>{
  console.log(await client.generate({ prompt: 'latency test' }));
})();
```

laura: run with REGION unset, you should see two outbound connections in tcpdump to different regions within the same request window.

sam: I'm creating INC-4321 for the customer with the repro and logs. billing please hold off automated invoice until we confirm credits.

billing: ack, hold placed.

eng-runtime: follow-ups: will open PR to (a) add server-side duplicate token suppression when client request-id header present, (b) add a safer default for region_policy when hedging is enabled (sticky by default). will link PRs here.

devex-bot: reminder: coordinate change with SDK team and docs if default behavior changes.

sam: thanks. I'll update customer with temporary env workaround and incident number. will follow up after eng PRs land. :thumbsup:
